Summarise how often water samples exceed a bacteria threshold after rain

Source: R/summarise_exceedance.R
summarise_exceedance.Rd

Groups water samples by the rain that fell in the 72 hours before each sample, then reports the share of samples in each rainfall band whose enterococci count was above threshold. This is the calculation behind the main chart in run_app().

Usage

summarise_exceedance(samples, threshold = 40, min_samples = 10)

Arguments

samples

A data frame of water samples with the columns enterococci and rain_72h_mm, such as beach_samples or a subset of it.

threshold

Enterococci count (cfu per 100 mL) above which a sample counts as unsafe. Defaults to 40, the strictest NHMRC category limit.

min_samples

Bands with fewer samples than this are flagged in the few_samples column, because their percentages are unreliable.

Value

A data frame with one row per rainfall band (Dry, Light, Moderate, Heavy) and the columns rain_band, n_samples, n_exceed, prop_exceed (share of samples above threshold, NA for an empty band) and few_samples.

Examples

bondi <- beach_samples[beach_samples$swim_site == "Bondi Beach", ]
summarise_exceedance(bondi)
#> # A tibble: 4 × 5
#>   rain_band                 n_samples n_exceed prop_exceed few_samples
#>   <fct>                         <int>    <int>       <dbl> <lgl>      
#> 1 "Dry\n(under 1 mm)"             215        8      0.0372 FALSE      
#> 2 "Light\n(1 to 10 mm)"           238       26      0.109  FALSE      
#> 3 "Moderate\n(10 to 25 mm)"        89       15      0.169  FALSE      
#> 4 "Heavy\n(25 mm or more)"         52       15      0.288  FALSE      
# Compare prop_exceed in the Dry and Heavy rows: a large gap means
# rain strongly raises the chance of poor water quality at Bondi.

summarise_exceedance(bondi, threshold = 200)
#> # A tibble: 4 × 5
#>   rain_band                 n_samples n_exceed prop_exceed few_samples
#>   <fct>                         <int>    <int>       <dbl> <lgl>      
#> 1 "Dry\n(under 1 mm)"             215        2     0.00930 FALSE      
#> 2 "Light\n(1 to 10 mm)"           238        6     0.0252  FALSE      
#> 3 "Moderate\n(10 to 25 mm)"        89        3     0.0337  FALSE      
#> 4 "Heavy\n(25 mm or more)"         52        2     0.0385  FALSE      
# A more lenient threshold gives lower percentages in every band
